tools.name: start_review_router_setup
tools.description: Create an inert GitHub-to-Slack setup plan and return one browser sign-in URL for the person completing setup.

tools.name: get_review_router_setup_status
tools.description: Read structured progress and the next required human action.

tools.name: preview_review_router_setup
tools.description: Read the exact current intent version and locked setup plan before asking a human to continue.

tools.name: apply_review_router_setup
tools.description: Idempotently create or reconcile the route after the person completing setup signed in, claimed the current intent, and connected both providers.

tools.name: send_review_router_test
tools.description: After route application, idempotently send one real Slack setup message through the production delivery path.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_review_router_setup_status, preview_review_router_setup · Public sink: send_review_router_test.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_review_router_setup_status, preview_review_router_setup · Public sink: send_review_router_test

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
